headline: An AI system has matched radiologists at spotting prostate cancer on MRI scans, according to a Radiology Business report.
score_reason: Pool score 5, lowered by 1: the article could not be opened, so the study's size, design and setting are unknown.
importance_line: Men having prostate MRI scans and the radiologists who read them are the people affected, but the study's size, design and whether it was tested in real clinics are unknown, so this is a headline claim only.
summary: Radiology Business reports that an AI system matched radiologists at detecting prostate cancer on MRI scans.
notes: Radiology Business returned HTTP 403 and AuntMinnie ('AI on par with radiologists for finding prostate cancer on MRI', 13 Oct 2026) also returned 403. Imaging Technology News on 13 Oct carried a DeepHealth (RadNet) release of 8 Oct 2026 about a different claim (AI plus radiologist could avoid 18.9% of biopsies, European Radiology); it is not assumed to be the same study and none of its numbers are used. Headline only.
